description: The Viral Wanderer is our new drop bar do-it-all adventure bike. Since Pinion announced their partnership with TRP on the drop bar brake lever/shifter combo built specifically for the new Smart.Shift electronic gearbox, we knew we had to be the first to market with a product that not only incorporates this technology, but also one that exceeds all expectations. Enter the Wanderer. Built around a 100mm travel mountain bike fork or a boost spacing mountain bike specific rigid fork, the Wanderer is a ready-to-go-adventure adventure bike with more than enough mounting points to carry any and all of your needed gear. This is a true drop bar mountain bike with tire clearance that can accommodate up to a 29” x 2.4” tires. This bike can go anywhere and do anything. The Wanderer: There are no limits.
